environment.description: Deployed identically but fronted by Cloudflare with the following configuration: Zone-level firewall rule (expression: http.request.uri.query contains "'" or http.request.uri.query contains "--" or http.request.uri.query contains ";" or http.request.uri.query contains "UNION" or http.request.uri.query contains "union" or http.request.uri.query contains "SELECT" or http.request.uri.query contains "select") action BLOCK. Additionally, the Cloudflare WAF Managed Ruleset 'Cloudflare OWASP Core Ruleset' is enabled at paranoia level 3 with anomaly threshold 25 (lowered from default 60), and rule group 942 (SQL Injection) scoring weight doubled. The zone SSL mode is Full (Strict) with authenticated origin pulls enabled, meaning the origin nginx only accepts connections presenting a valid Cloudflare client certificate — direct-to-origin bypass is not possible.

config.custom_firewall_rule: block if query string contains: ' -- ; UNION union SELECT select
